_comment: Bedrock Privacy Extensions catalog. Data only — the C++ in catalog/ never
hardcodes an entry. Validated by scripts/check_catalog.py in CI.
Refreshed from a signed static manifest (docs/design/041), so the catalog
can be updated without shipping a new browser and without a Bedrock server.
Every entry carries its OWN license and attribution: the license of the
site that recommends a tool never covers the tool itself.
Recommendation source and licenses verified against upstream on 2026-08-21.

signature.note: Verified by an injected SignatureVerifier; an unsigned or badly signed manifest is refused and the packaged catalog is kept.

sources.name: PrivacyTools.io
sources.attribution_text: Privacy recommendations and selected reference materials: PrivacyTools.io
sources.notes: Permissive (WTFPL-derived) with one binding condition: a clear, visible, working credit link back to https://www.privacytools.io, and no implication of endorsement. Their names and marks are not granted. Third-party tools, guides and trademarks they link to keep their own licenses — see docs/LICENSING.md section 8.

extensions.name: uBlock Origin
extensions.description: Wide-spectrum content blocker with user-supplied filter lists.
extensions.privacy_purpose: Blocks advertising, tracking and malware domains before they load.
extensions.attribution: uBlock Origin © Raymond Hill, GPL-3.0-or-later. Recommended by PrivacyTools.io.
extensions.why_recommended: The reference content blocker. Bedrock's built-in blocking already covers the same ground with the same filter syntax, so this is listed for users who want to bring their own rules rather than as an addition to ours.
extensions.overlap_note: Substantially duplicated by Bedrock's built-in blocking.

extensions.name: uBlock Origin Lite
extensions.description: Declarative, permission-light content blocker for Manifest V3.
extensions.privacy_purpose: Blocks ads and trackers without a persistent background process.
extensions.attribution: uBlock Origin Lite © Raymond Hill, GPL-3.0-or-later. Recommended by PrivacyTools.io.
extensions.why_recommended: Runs under Manifest V3, so it works in the current engine. Overlaps Bedrock's built-in blocking almost completely.
extensions.overlap_note: Substantially duplicated by Bedrock's built-in blocking.

extensions.name: ClearURLs
extensions.description: Removes tracking parameters from links and redirects.
extensions.privacy_purpose: Stops click identifiers travelling with a URL when it is shared or followed.
extensions.attribution: ClearURLs © Kevin Röbert, LGPL-3.0-only. Recommended by PrivacyTools.io.
extensions.why_recommended: Adds a specialised layer: Bedrock strips tracking parameters it recognises, this maintains a much larger rule set for the ones it does not.
extensions.overlap_note: Partial overlap with Bedrock's tracking parameter filtering.

extensions.name: Cookie AutoDelete
extensions.description: Deletes cookies and site data when a tab closes, with a per-site allow list.
extensions.privacy_purpose: Keeps site state from outliving the visit that created it.
extensions.attribution: Cookie AutoDelete © Kenny Do and contributors, MIT. Recommended by PrivacyTools.io.
extensions.why_recommended: Bedrock partitions storage per site but keeps it; this removes it after the tab closes, which is a different behaviour rather than a stronger version of the same one.
extensions.overlap_note: No Bedrock feature deletes site data on tab close.

extensions.name: Decentraleyes
extensions.description: Serves common front-end libraries locally instead of from a CDN.
extensions.privacy_purpose: Avoids a request to a third-party CDN for every page that uses a shared library.
extensions.attribution: Decentraleyes © Thomas Rientjes, MPL-2.0. Recommended by PrivacyTools.io.
extensions.why_recommended: Covers CDN requests that content blocking leaves alone. Its bundled library versions age, which is why the verification date matters more here than elsewhere.
extensions.overlap_note: No overlap with a built-in Bedrock feature.
